reason: The plugin is a UI layout utility for DeepSeek Harness Web that adjusts chat area width by overriding existing CSS variables (and related composer width), with a configurable width setting. Evidence indicates no additional features beyond presentation/layout behavior.

summaries.zh: 该插件用于在 DeepSeek Harness Web 中加宽对话内容区域，通过覆盖 CSS 变量设置聊天界面宽度，并可在配置中调整该宽度。
summaries.en: This plugin widens the DeepSeek Harness Web chat content area by overriding CSS width variables, with a configurable width setting to customize the conversation layout.

capabilities: Overrides DeepSeek chat UI CSS variables to change conversation/content width
Reads a configurable width parameter to control the target layout size
Injects CSS at runtime through the web plugin patch path

reasons.code: README describes widening the conversation content area by overriding --dsh-chat-content-width with a configurable default
README states the plugin’s sole responsibility is conversation content width and that it injects a <style> element at runtime
package.json marks plugin as web platform with a DSH bundle patch configuration
